headline: Frontline Shifts Intensify at Dead Lands, Fishermans Row
war_summary: Since the 1510 edition the battle‑line has narrowed to a few burning sectors. Dead Lands remains the bloodiest theatre, recording four base changes in the last six hours and fifteen over the past day, with combined casualties still above 2,700 per hour. Fishermans Row, quiet in the last two hours, has logged six flips in the past six hours and twenty‑five in twenty‑four, keeping it the most volatile hex. Godcrofts has surged, posting five ownership changes in the latest two‑hour window and seven in six hours, while Farranac Coast added three captures in the same period. Lykos Isle continues to bleed heavily, producing eight flips over the day though none in the last six hours. Linn Mercy, despite heavy losses, shows seven daily flips but no fresh moves recently. Meanwhile the massive attrition zones — Weathered Expanse, Callahans Passage, Kings Cage, Marban Hollow, Loch Mor, Stlican Shelf and Stonecradle — keep bleeding manpower with casualty rates climbing or holding steady, yet without territorial movement. Base turnover is now concentrated in Dead Lands, Fishermans Row, Godcrofts and Farranac Coast, while the broader front remains locked in static, high‑casualty grinding.
